verdict.rationale: Docs indicate agents can be engaged via mentions in comments and interact with teams in Slack (codegen-docs-23, codegen-docs-2), implying some capacity to send follow-up input during a task, but there is no explicit documentation of continuing/steering an already-running agent session without restarting it. Missing for 10: explicit 'send follow-up message to active session' feature, session persistence details, and independent confirmation that mid-task steering doesn't require a new run.
